MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-backed bar magnets felt useful for mounting small items, which connects directly to my recent magnetic hook purchases.",
    "The small magnets recognized my interest in magnetic hardware, although interest alone was not enough for me to choose them without a clear use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fishing magnet shares a material with my hooks, but retrieving objects from a river serves a completely different purpose from organizing items on metal surfaces.",
    "The wire connectors and grinding discs assume projects I am not currently doing; buying screws and washers does not mean I need electrical repair or sanding supplies.",
    "The COVID test has no connection to my current hardware needs, and the thousand-count gloves offer far more disposable protection than I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in magnetic hooks seemed to be treated as interest in magnets of any size or purpose.",
    "My fastener purchases seemed to suggest interest in workshop supplies broadly, even when they serve unrelated tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The practical purpose matters: I am interested in fastening, mounting and storage, especially items with an obvious use alongside my hooks and screws.",
    "Size, attachment method and quantity affect whether something is useful now; tiny loose magnets and bulk gloves do not become worthwhile just because they could be handy someday."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in magnetic mounting hardware but stretched it into unrelated magnetic activities and workshop projects."
}
